summary_en: 500,000 shares (3.4% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) up to ¥5,305M via ToSTNeT-3 at ¥10,610/share on 2026-06-11 08:45 JST. Separate block from ongoing ¥10B program (¥1.2M limit; 892,800 shares acquired to date). Treasury excluded from denominator: 14,708,061 shares ex-treasury as of 2026-05-31.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares via off-auction trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: MegaChips Corporation resolved via written board decision on 2026-06-10 to acquire treasury shares in a block transaction separate from its ongoing buyback program. The company will purchase up to 500,000 shares (3.4% of the 14,708,061 shares outstanding excluding treasury as of 2026-05-31) for an aggregate limit of ¥5,305,000,000 via off-auction trading (ToSTNeT-3) on 2026-06-11 at 08:45 JST. The closing price on 2026-06-10 was ¥10,610 per share, which serves as the execution price for this block. The company stated the block purchase addresses demand from certain shareholders to minimize market-price impact, conducted independently of the ¥10 billion program authorized 2026-02-06 (1,200,000 shares limit; 892,800 shares acquired through 2026-06-10). Results will be disclosed after market close on 2026-06-11. Execution is contingent on matching sell orders; no changes to share count or trading venue are contemplated.
